arxiv-2101-03188.title: Breath Figure Spot: a Recovery Concentration manifestation
arxiv-2101-03188.creator: Ali Alshehri, Pirouz Kavehpour
arxiv-2101-03188.description: Abstract Directing a jet of humid air to impinge on a surface that is cooled below the dew point results in micro-sized water droplets. Lord Rayleigh discussed the phenomenon by contrasting clean to flame-exposed glass and called such behaviour Breath Figures (BF). Historically, utilizing dew as a water source was investigated by several scientists dating back to Aristotle.

arxiv-2102-06355.title: Same File, Different Changes: The Potential of Meta-Maintenance on GitHub
arxiv-2102-06355.creator: Hideaki Hata, 1 Raula Gaikovina Kula, 1 Takashi Ishio, 1 Christoph Treude 2
arxiv-2102-06355.description: Abstract Online collaboration platforms such as GitHub have provided software developers with the ability to easily reuse and share code between repositories. With clone-and-own and forking becoming prevalent, maintaining these shared files is important, especially for keeping the most up-to-date version of reused code. Different to related work, we propose the concept of meta-maintenance—i.e.

arxiv-2109-05670.title: Experimental study of tune-out wavelengths for spin-dependent optical lattice in 87 Rb Bose-Einstein condensation
arxiv-2109-05670.creator: Kai Wen, Zengming Meng, Liangwei Wang, Liangchao Chen, Lianghui Huang, Pengjun Wang, Jing Zhang
arxiv-2109-05670.description: Abstract We study the periodic potential of one-dimensional optical lattice originated from scalar shift and vector shift by manipulating the lattice polarizations. The ac Stark shift of optical lattice is measured by Kapitza-Dirac scattering of 87 Rb Bose-Einstein condensate and the characteristics of spin-dependent optical lattice are presented by scanning the lattice wavelength between the D1 and D2 lines.

arxiv-2205-13937.title: Deep Face Recognition with Clustering based Domain Adaptation
arxiv-2205-13937.creator: Mei Wang, Weihong Deng
arxiv-2205-13937.description: Abstract Despite great progress in face recognition tasks achieved by deep convolution neural networks (CNNs), these models often face challenges in real world tasks where training images gathered from Internet are different from test images because of different lighting condition, pose and image quality.

arxiv-2310-00978.title: Convergence to decorated Lévy processes in non-Skorohod topologies for dynamical systems
arxiv-2310-00978.creator: Ana Cristina Moreira Freitas, Jorge Milhazes Freitas, Ian Melbourne, Mike Todd
arxiv-2310-00978.description: Abstract We present a general framework for weak convergence to decorated Lévy processes in enriched spaces of càdlàg functions for vector-valued processes arising in deterministic systems. Applications include uniformly expanding maps and unbounded observables as well as nonuniformly expanding/hyperbolic maps with bounded observables. The latter includes intermittent maps and dispersing billiards with flat cusps.

arxiv-2509-04606.title: Sample-efficient Integration of New Modalities into Large Language Models
arxiv-2509-04606.creator: Osman Batur İnce André F. T. Martins Oisin Mac Aodha Edoardo M. Ponti
arxiv-2509-04606.description: Abstract Multimodal foundation models can process several modalities. However, since the space of possible modalities is large and evolving over time, training a model from scratch to encompass all modalities is unfeasible. Moreover, integrating a modality into a pre-existing foundation model currently requires a significant amount of paired data, which is often not available for low-resource modalities.

arxiv-2510-20426.title: Vacancy diffusion on a brominated Si(100) surface: Critical effect of the dangling bond charge state
arxiv-2510-20426.creator: T. V. Pavlova, V. M. Shevlyuga
arxiv-2510-20426.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by T. V. Pavlova, V. M. Shevlyuga. Silicon dangling bonds (DBs) on an adsorbate-covered Si(100) surface can be created in a scanning tunneling microscope (STM) with high precision required for a number of applications. However, vacancies containing DBs can diffuse, disrupting precisely created structures. In this work, we study the diffusion of Br vacancies on a Si(100)-2 × \times 1-Br surface in an STM under typical imaging conditions. In agreement with previous work, Br vacancies diffuse at a positive sample bias voltage.

arxiv-2601-05149.title: Multi-Scale Local Speculative Decoding for Image Generation
arxiv-2601-05149.creator: Elia PeruzzoGuillaume SautièreAmirhossein Habibian
arxiv-2601-05149.description: Abstract Autoregressive (AR) models have achieved remarkable success in image synthesis, yet their sequential nature imposes significant latency constraints. Speculative Decoding offers a promising avenue for acceleration, but existing approaches are limited by token-level ambiguity and lack of spatial awareness.

arxiv-2601-11306.title: Representations of Spectrum of G ​ L ​ ( m ) GL(m) type Quantum Matrices Thanks: Pavel.Saponov@ihep.ru Thanks: mzaicev02@gmail.com
arxiv-2601-11306.creator: Dimitry Gurevich
arxiv-2601-11306.description: Abstract In the present paper we are dealing with reflection equation algebras ℒ ⁡ ( R ) {\cal{L}}(R) corresponding to even skew-invertible Hecke symmetries. Our main result consists in computing the characters of the spectral values of the generating matrix L L of ℒ ⁡ ( R ) {\cal{L}}(R) in finite-dimensional representations labeled by partitions of integers.

europmc-pmc9674619.title: Mutant p53 in cancer: from molecular mechanism to therapeutic modulation.
europmc-pmc9674619.creator: Chen X, Zhang T, Su W, Dou Z, Zhao D, Jin X, Lei H, Wang J, Xie X, Cheng B, Li Q, Zhang H, Di C.
europmc-pmc9674619.description: TP53, a crucial tumor suppressor gene, is the most commonly mutated gene in human cancers. Aside from losing its tumor suppressor function, mutant p53 (mutp53) often acquires inherent, novel oncogenic functions, which is termed "gain-of-function". Emerging evidence suggests that

pmc-10576118.title: Dual-pocket inhibition of Nav channels by the antiepileptic drug lamotrigine
pmc-10576118.creator: Jian Huang, Xiao Fan, Xueqin Jin, Liming Teng, Nieng Yan
pmc-10576118.description: SignificanceDissecting the mechanism of action of clinical drugs on human Nav channels will aid future drug discovery for the treatment of neurological and psychiatric disorders. The high-resolution cryo-EM structures of Nav1.7 in complex with two medications, lamotrigine (LTG) and riluzole (RLZ), reveal the working mechanism of these drugs.

pmc-11306222.title: Global remote feature modulation end-to-end detection
pmc-11306222.creator: XiaoAn Bao, WenJing Yi, XiaoMei Tu, Na Zhang, QingQi Zhang, YuTing Jin, Biao Wu
pmc-11306222.description: Object detector based on fully convolutional network achieves excellent performance. However, existing detection algorithms still face challenges such as low detection accuracy in dense scenes and issues with occlusion of dense targets. To address these two challenges, we propose an Global Remote Feature Modulation End-to-End (GRFME2E) detection algorithm.

pmc-11398041.title: Adaptive Finite-Time-Based Neural Optimal Control of Time-Delayed Wheeled Mobile Robotics Systems
pmc-11398041.creator: Shu Li, Tao Ren, Liang Ding, Lei Liu
pmc-11398041.description: For nonlinear systems with uncertain state time delays, an adaptive neural optimal tracking control method based on finite time is designed. With the help of the appropriate LKFs, the time-delay problem is handled. A novel nonquadratic Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman (HJB) function is defined, where finite time is selected as the upper limit of integration.

pmc-11433717.title: Comparison of Fracture Strength of Milled and 3D-Printed Crown Materials According to Occlusal Thickness
pmc-11433717.creator: Yeseul Park, Jimin Kim, You-Jung Kang, Eun-Young Shim, Jee-Hwan Kim, Javier Gil, Marta Pegueroles, Andreu Puigdollers, Alberto Caprioglio
pmc-11433717.description: This study aimed to measure the fracture strengths and hardness of final restorative milled and 3D-printed materials and evaluate the appropriate crown thickness for their clinical use for permanent prosthesis. One type of milled material (group M) and two types of 3D-printed materials (groups P1 and P2) were used. Their crown thickness was set to 0.5, 1.0, and 1.

pmc-11518454.title: Are migrant workers at greater risk of workplace deaths? A systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11518454.creator: K Lau, R Aldridge, M Norredam, G F Mkoma, M Kugan, RCY Lin, L Kiss, C Zimmerman, S Hargreaves
pmc-11518454.description: BackgroundGlobally, 170 million individuals migrate for work. Yet, evidence on their mortality risk remains unclear. Our aim was to synthesize global evidence on migrant worker mortality risk compared to local workers and to identify the multiple intersecting social determinants of mortality.MethodsWe conducted a systematic review of peer-reviewed literature which reported on mortality outcome of migrant workers.

pmc-11643860.title: Rational Design of Novel Single-Atom Catalysts of Transition-Metal-Doped 2D AlN Monolayer as Highly Effective Electrocatalysts for Nitrogen Reduction Reaction
pmc-11643860.creator: Xiaopeng Shen, Qinfang Zhang, Charles C Chusuei, Le Li, Dan Zhang
pmc-11643860.description: The single-atom catalysts (SACs) for the electrocatalytic nitrogen reduction reaction (NRR) have garnered significant attention in recent years. The NRR is regarded as a milder and greener approach to ammonia synthesis. The pursuit of highly efficient and selective electrocatalysts for the NRR continues to garner substantial interest, yet it poses a significant challenge.

pmc-12362919.title: Identification of anti-fibrotic compounds from Piper longum L via hollow fiber cell fishing and high-performance liquid chromatography with in vivo and in vitro validation
pmc-12362919.creator: Jie Tian, Nan Zhou, Heng Wang, Wanghui Jing, Guoping Zheng
pmc-12362919.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundTraditional Chinese medicine (TCM) is an important source of bioactive compounds, hence enjoying a wide application in clinical treatment, while its pharmacodynamic material basis remains difficult to elucidate as it has a complex chemical composition. Piper longum L is a commonly used herbal medicine in prescriptions for chronic kidney disease (CKD), yet its key active ingredients responsible for anti-renal fibrosis effects remain unclear.

pmc-12651257.title: Adoption of Hypofractionated and Ultrahypofractionated Adjuvant Radiation Therapy for Breast Cancer Across Main and Community Centers Within a Single Healthcare System
pmc-12651257.creator: Leila T Tchelebi, Ajay Kapur, Clary Evans
pmc-12651257.description: Simple SummaryAfter breast cancer surgery, many people receive radiation therapy, which can be delivered over many or few visits. We asked whether doctors at our main university hospital switched to shorter schedules faster than doctors at our eight community clinics.

pmc-12785556.title: Polyethylene Glycol (PEG)-Based Wet-Adhesive Absorbable Bone Wax for Osseous Hemostasis and Repair
pmc-12785556.creator: Huiqiang Cheng, Aiping Yang, Guoyu Lv, Heng Zheng, Hong Li
pmc-12785556.description: The non-absorbability and biological inertia of traditional bone wax often result in foreign body retention, inhibit bone healing, and increase the risk of infection. Herein, a novel absorbable bone wax was developed by mixing polyethylene glycol (PEG), tannic acid (TA), sodium carboxymethyl cellulose (CMC), and low-molecular-weight poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA) via one-pot method.

pmc-12976466.title: Current Treatment Patterns and Outcomes of Sex Cord Stromal Tumor Patients in Japan
pmc-12976466.creator: Takashige Abe, Kosuke Miyai, Toyonori Tsuzuki, Sachiyo Murai, Katsuyoshi Hashine, Shinichi Yamashita, Takashi Kawahara, Naotaka Nishiyama, Hiroshi Kitamura, Hiroshi Kikuchi, Kazutaka Saito, Hatsuki Hibi, Haruka Miyata, Ryuji Matsumoto, Takahiro Osawa, Hiroyuki Nishiyama, Nobuo Shinohara
pmc-12976466.description: ObjectivesSex cord‐stromal tumors (SCSTs) constitute approximately 5% of testicular malignancies. This investigation aimed to elucidate contemporary therapeutic approaches and clinical outcomes for patients with testicular SCSTs in Japan.MethodsParticipating institutions included Japan Clinical Oncology Group facilities, affiliated centers, and institutions with published cases. Clinical data and histopathological findings were compiled. Central pathological review involved representative tissue sections when available.

pmc-13388662.title: Role of garnet shaping the 660-km seismic discontinuity
pmc-13388662.creator: Takayuki Ishii, Hiroshi Kojitani, Masaki Akaogi
pmc-13388662.description: The 660-km discontinuity is commonly attributed to the post-spinel transition of ringwoodite to bridgmanite and ferropericlase, yet it does not fully explain observed structural complexity. Here, we examine the influence of majorite garnet, the second most abundant mantle mineral, on the post-spinel transition using high-pressure and high-temperature experiments.

pmc-13628546.title: FvGI–FvCO–FvFT1 pathway activates FvTFL1 in long days to repress flowering in woodland strawberry (Fragaria vesca)
pmc-13628546.creator: Quan Zhou, Sergei Lembinen, Tuomas Toivainen, Takeshi Kurokura, Guangxun Fan, Paula Elomaa, Elli Koskela, Timo Hytönen
pmc-13628546.description: Summary Photoperiod is a stable seasonal signal. Although photoperiodic flowering is well understood in short‐day (SD) and long‐day (LD) annual plants, the regulatory mechanisms in perennials remain elusive. In a perennial woodland strawberry (Fragaria vesca), flowering is induced in SDs in autumn and plants flower following spring, while in plants with mutated FvTERMINAL FLOWER1 (FvTFL1), LDs induce flowering.

pmc-13673555.title: Human immunodeficiency virus infection mimicking very early onset inflammatory bowel disease
pmc-13673555.creator: Rasha Abi Radi Abou Jaoudeh, Cary Sauer, Teresa Oh
pmc-13673555.description: Very early onset inflammatory bowel disease (VEO‐IBD), defined as diagnosis before 6 years of age, is often associated with immune dysregulation and monogenic etiologies; however, infectious mimics may be overlooked in low‐prevalence regions. We report a 4‐year‐old male with poor weight gain, intermittent diarrhea, elevated fecal calprotectin, and persistently elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate.
